title: 集點貼紙
question: 買滿 100 元送一張集點貼紙。請輸入消費金額，滿 100 元（含）先輸出「送你一張集點貼紙」；不論有沒有送，最後都輸出「謝謝光臨」。

test_case.output:
送你一張集點貼紙
謝謝光臨

en.title: Sticker Gift
en.question: Spend 100 dollars or more and get a sticker. Input how much you spent. If it is 100 or more, output "Here is a sticker". Then always output "Thank you".

test_case.output:
Here is a sticker
Thank you
